Causal test of the L19 prefill DoM direction (corrupt-to-clean activation patching during decoding): verdict DIAGNOSTIC. The L19 prefill DoM is a correlational readout of correctness, NOT a causal lever — intervening on it does not change answer correctness. This kills DoM-based steering (fixed-vector steering was already refuted by P10v2 direction-rotation) and any experiment whose premise is that patching, ablating, noising, or steering the DoM/correctness direction will move accuracy. The project line is routing/selective-prediction using the readout, not interventions on it.
